context: Evaluates whether the agent respects design-debate's scope boundary when a plan file already exists, redirecting to plan-review instead of running a debate.

checklist.name: Detects existing plan file
checklist.description: Agent notices the referenced path is an already-written plan file, not an undecided idea

checklist.name: States scope mismatch explicitly
checklist.description: Agent explicitly says this request falls outside design-debate's scope

checklist.name: Names plan-review
checklist.description: Agent names plan-review by name as the correct tool for reviewing an existing plan

checklist.name: No brief composed
checklist.description: No identical-brief grounding step is performed for a debate that shouldn't run

checklist.name: No finding persisted
checklist.description: No context-file finding is written for this request

checklist.name: No known-issue persisted
checklist.description: No context-file KNOWN_ISSUE is written for this request

checklist.name: No silent redirect
checklist.description: The redirect is stated to the user, not just silently assumed

checklist.name: No adr-capture invoked
checklist.description: adr-capture is not triggered since no debate verdict exists to reveal a decision
